title: Asahina Mafuyu — Elpis At The Depths Of Despair〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Elpis At The Depths Of Despair（4★）
meta.Event: Someday, From the Depths of Despair

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, Yuki!
We were just talking about you and K♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, about what happened two years ago.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <There were some things that we learned for the first time, so we were just saying how nice it was to hear that story.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
And as usual, you don't really care...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, cut her some slack.
She literally just got here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But while we're at it, are there any other really interesting things about you two that we still don't know about?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Huh? Um...
Not off the top of my head...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It'd be something more recent as opposed to two years ago...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K and I took a psychological test this one time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, you two took a psychological test together?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think it was around the time we'd just started going over to SEKAI and I asked the housekeeper who's been coming over to my place about Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She suggested that a psychological test could help determine what a person's conscious and subconscious selves are actually like.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I had no idea! K, do you have the results of that test saved somewhere?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Awesome! Since you two took it, we should totally take it too♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'd be lying if I said that I'm not interested.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <By the way, how much did it get right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, here it is...
I'll start reading each question.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Imagine you're walking on a beach, alone. The weather is pleasant and the sound of the gentle waves is very soothing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You keep walking until you arrive at a small harbor. A single boat is moored there.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Question one: What size is the boat?
Would it be easy or difficult to get on it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Maybe... A yacht or sailboat? Yeah, let's go with a sailboat that I'm eagerly about to board!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... I'd say it's a big cruise liner. One that you can board by invitation only!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. I said that it's a big ship that only invited guests could board, so I'd have trouble joining them.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Whoa, that's pretty much the same answer...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Something small and run down.
I'd avoid boarding it since there's a hole in the hull.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I-Interesting...
I'm curious as to what that tells us about you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <There's still another question, so let's do that before we look at the analysis section.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Question two: You get on the boat.
There is an animal on it. What animal is it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Animal...? Oh, I'd want them to either be a hedgehog or chinchilla. They're so tiny and cute!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Is that so? Don't you mean you want to take pics of them to post online?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wh-What are you talking about?!
Anyway, Amia, you're next.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Alright, alright. I'd say... A flamingo!
They're adorably pink and we could travel together!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I guess that suits you pretty well, Amia. What did you two say, K, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?! Why'd you two pick something scary?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, what does this say about us?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The first question has to do with one's ambitions. The bigger the ship, the greater one's ambitions supposedly are...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Also, saying that this ship would be easy to board means that you have a very open mind.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You prefer to close yourself off and brood on your own.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm... So it's pretty much right about not having friends, but not so much about brooding or whatever since she likes to lash out...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Just who exactly are you talking about?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um... The second question had to do with how satisfied you are in terms of your day-to-day life.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Choosing something that more or less counts as a pet means you're essentially happy, but small animals mean the opposite...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anything along the lines of livestock means one appears to be happy but feels some sort of doubt deep down. Anything big or scary means this person's a ticking timebomb of stress.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean... Hedgehogs and chinchillas count as pets, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. Most people would say dogs or cats when it comes to pets, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But where do flamingos fit into all this?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Don't animals at a zoo more or less count as livestock?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What?! No way! Why can't they be pets?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, based on that logic, you'd have to lop lions in with cattle.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And forget what I said. K and Yuki picked monsters by comparison!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I mean, a shark and a dragon?
And what it said about being ticking timebombs...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We took this quite a long time ago. I can't say that I'm feeling that much stress now...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha...
To be fair, they might give different responses if they took this now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right. Shall we get started?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, but that was actually a pretty fun test! Anyway, I'm putting myself on mute now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I probably would pick something other than a dragon, but what...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That can wait...
For now, I need to work.
